# Chapter 3 — Oscillation

Source: https://natureofcode.com/oscillation/

Key concepts: angular motion, sine/cosine waves, amplitude, period, oscillation as simple harmonic motion, polar coordinates, springs, pendulums.

Seeds:
- Oscillation chapter uses sine and cosine for periodic motion and waves.
- Angular velocity and amplitude control the shape of the oscillation.
- Springs and pendulums are built from force + angular relationships.
